abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）的可靠和直观控制仍然是脑机接口（BCI）系统的主要挑战，特别是在动态的现实环境中。基于稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）的BCI精度较高，但可能会导致视觉疲劳；而肌电图（EMG）提供了运动相关信号的附加信息，可以提高BCI性能的适应性，特别是在动态任务上。因此，这种混合 BCI 协议通过集成两种生理脑电图 (EEG) 和 EMG 信号，为无人机控制提供了可靠的框架。评估实验表明混合EEG-...
abstract_en: Reliable and intuitive control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains a major challenge for brain-computer interface (BCI) systems, particularly in dynamic real-world environments. Steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) based BCI has high precision, however, it may cause visual tiredness; while Electromyography (EMG) provides additional information of motor related signals which can improve the adaptability of the performance for BCI especially on the dynamic tasks. Therefore, this hybrid BCI protocol provides a reliable framework for UAV control by integrating the two physiological Electroencephalography (EEG) and EMG signals. The evaluation experiment indicated that hybrid EEG-EMG control obtained higher accuracy than unimodal methods, and the errors caused by the incorrect perception can be decreased.

title_zh: 使用镍粉环氧复合材料的纯线圈 EMAT 背衬设计
title_en: Backing Design for Coil-only EMAT using Nickel-powder Epoxy Composite
authors: Yini Song；Kai WANG；Yiru Xiao；Jun Tu；Bo Feng；Yihua Kang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 仅线圈磁致伸缩兰姆波检测采用镍片作为波导和超声激励结构的组成部分，但这种配置通常会产生多个回波脉冲，从而模糊解释。为了减轻不必要的反射，我们在激励边缘处用 5 毫米宽的镍粉环氧复合材料条涂覆镍基板。为了直接比较，我们在相同位置应用了相同宽度的纯环氧树脂条。经过带通滤波和基线校正后，我们计算了反射窗口内的 RMS 能量。相对于未涂层对照的能量吸收比表明，镍粉复合材料衰减兰姆波能量的效率高出两到三倍……
abstract_en: Coil-only magnetostrictive Lamb-wave detection employs a nickel sheet both as the waveguide and as an integral part of the ultrasonic excitation structure, but this configuration often produces multiple echo pulses that obscure interpretation. To mitigate unwanted reflections, we coated the nickel substrate with 5 mm-wide strips of nickelpowder epoxy composite at the excitation edge. For direct comparison, we applied pure epoxy strips of identical width at the same locations. Following band-pass filtering and baseline correction, we computed the RMS energy within the reflection window. Energy absorption ratios relative to an uncoated control show that the nickel-powder composite attenuates Lamb-wave energy two to three times more effectively than pure epoxy. Viscoelastic damping in the epoxy resin combined with scattering at metal–polymer interfaces drives this enhanced dissipation. These results clarify the key absorption mechanisms and inform the design of high-efficiency backing materials for Lamb-wave transduction in thin plates.

title_zh: 探索视觉引导在基于运动想象的脑机接口中的作用：脑电图微状态特定功能连接研究
title_en: Exploring the Role of Visual Guidance in Motor Imagery-Based Brain-Computer Interface: An EEG Microstate-Specific Functional Connectivity Study

abstract_zh: 基于运动想象的脑机接口（BCI）已被广泛认为是康复应用的有益工具。此外，引入视觉引导运动想象来改善康复效果。然而，支持这些技术的报告结果仍然不能令人满意。脑电图 (EEG) 信号可以通过一系列有限数量的地形（微观状态）来表示。为了探索动态大脑激活模式，我们在运动想象（MI）、运动执行（ME）和引导 MI（GMI）条件下对脑电图数据进行了脑电图微状态和微状态特定的功能连接分析。通过比较十六个微观状态参数，...
abstract_en: Motor imagery-based brain-computer interfaces (BCI) have been widely recognized as beneficial tools for rehabilitation applications. Moreover, visually guided motor imagery was introduced to improve the rehabilitation impact. However, the reported results to support these techniques remain unsatisfactory. Electroencephalography (EEG) signals can be represented by a sequence of a limited number of topographies (microstates). To explore the dynamic brain activation patterns, we conducted EEG microstate and microstate-specific functional connectivity analyses on EEG data under motor imagery (MI), motor execution (ME), and guided MI (GMI) conditions. By comparing sixteen microstate parameters, the brain activation patterns induced by GMI show more similarities to ME than MI from a microstate perspective. The mean duration and duration of microstate four are proposed as biomarkers to evaluate motor condition. A support vector machine (SVM) classifier trained with microstate parameters achieved average accuracies of 80.27% and 66.30% for ME versus MI and GMI classification, respectively. Further, functional connectivity patterns showed a strong relationship with microstates. Key node analysis shows clear switching of key node distribution between brain areas among different microstates. The neural mechanism of the switching pattern is discussed. While microstate analysis indicates similar brain dynamics between GMI and ME, graph theory-based microstate-specific functional connectivity analysis implies that visual guidance may reduce the functional integration of the brain network during MI. Thus, we proposed that combined MI and GMI for BCI can improve neurorehabilitation effects. The present findings provide insights for understanding the neural mechanism of microstates, the role of visual guidance in MI tasks, and the experimental basis for developing new BCI-aided rehabilitation systems.
